name: read_cells
description: Read a rectangular range of computed cell values. Reads go through authorize(): cells the principal cannot read come back as #PERM! errors, never leaked values.

name: create_chart
description: Create a NATIVE chart in the sheet, bound to sheet data: the chart is inserted into the workbook itself, is visible in the grid, persists, and saves with the file. "range" is an A1 string (e.g. "A1:C10") that INCLUDES the header row; the first column holds category labels and each remaining numeric column becomes a series. "kind" is one of column|bar|line|area|pie|doughnut (fail-closed: any other kind is rejected). "anchor" is an optional A1 cell for the chart's top-left placement; default is below the data range. This is NOT analyze_data (which only shows an ephemeral chart in chat).

name: write_cells
description: Write literal values to cells. A string value starting with "=" is treated as a formula by the engine. Writes go through authorize(): locked cells and read-only principals are rejected per cell.

name: set_formulas
description: Set formulas on cells. Formulas may omit the leading "=" (it is added automatically).

name: recalculate
description: Force a full recalculation of the workbook.

name: get_results
description: Read the full used-range values of a sheet. Goes through authorize(): cells the principal cannot read come back as #PERM! errors.

name: create_pivot
description: Build a PivotTable over a rectangular range (first row is the header). Stores a versioned pivot spec in the service metadata and returns a summary.

name: refresh_pivot
description: Recompute a stored PivotTable against the current source range values.

name: get_pivot_data
description: Return the full rendered matrix of a stored PivotTable.

name: subscribe
description: Subscribe to engine events. Events are buffered per subscription; drain them with poll_events.

name: unsubscribe
description: Remove an event subscription. Buffered events are discarded.

name: list_subscriptions
description: List active event subscriptions.

name: poll_events
description: Drain buffered events for a subscription (oldest first). The MCP stdio transport is request/response, so clients poll; this is what the AI Agent proactivity loop uses.

name: memory_load
description: Load a value from the agent long-term memory (per-user service metadata).

name: memory_save
description: Save a value to the agent long-term memory (per-user service metadata). Overwrites any existing value.

name: memory_update
description: Patch a value in the agent long-term memory. When both stored and new values are objects, shallow-merge; otherwise replace.

name: agent.ask_question
description: Human-in-the-loop: ask the user a free-text question. The tool call PAUSES the agent until the user answers via agent.answer_pending (or the wait times out — it never hangs forever). There is no path around MCP.

name: agent.offer_options
description: Human-in-the-loop: ask the user to choose one of the offered options. The tool call PAUSES the agent until the user answers via agent.answer_pending (or the wait times out). There is no path around MCP.

name: agent.request_approval
description: Human-in-the-loop: request the user's approval before a broad or destructive action (ai-agent.md §7). The tool call PAUSES the agent until the user approves or denies via agent.answer_pending (or the wait times out). Ambiguous answers are treated as denied with the text kept as a note — the agent must never guess. There is no path around MCP.

name: agent.answer_pending
description: Deliver the human's answer to a pending ask, unblocking the paused agent.* tool call. Principal-scoped (ai-agent.md §3): only the principal the ask was created for can answer it — anyone else gets an authorization error.

name: agent.list_pending
description: List the caller's pending human-in-the-loop asks (ai-agent.md §12) — what the paused agent is waiting for. Principal-scoped: only the caller's own asks are returned.

name: appbuilder_create_spec
description: Create a no-code app spec (versioned, serializable) in the service metadata store. The spec is validated; invalid specs are rejected with the validation errors. Requires the app manage right.

name: appbuilder_update_spec
description: Replace a stored app spec (full replacement after validation; older versions are migrated). The spec id must match. Requires the app manage right.

name: appbuilder_get_spec
description: Fetch a stored app spec by id.

name: appbuilder_list_specs
description: List stored app specs (id, name, version, views, actions).

name: appbuilder_delete_spec
description: Delete a stored app spec by id. Requires the app manage right.

name: report_create_spec
description: Create a native report spec (versioned, serializable) in the service metadata store. The spec is migrated forward and validated; invalid specs are rejected with the validation errors. Requires the report manage right.

name: report_update_spec
description: Replace a stored report spec (full replacement after migration + validation; older versions migrate forward). The spec id must match. Requires the report manage right.

name: report_get_spec
description: Fetch a stored report spec by id. Requires the report read right.

name: report_list_specs
description: List stored report specs (id, name, version, bindings, visuals, refresh mode). Requires the report read right.

name: report_delete_spec
description: Delete a stored report spec by id. Requires the report manage right.

name: analyze_data
description: Run the data-analysis pipeline on a sheet range: extracts the data schema, classifies the analytical intent ("analyze the data and show me a diagram", "pivot this", "forecast next quarter", ...), generates a versioned Python script, executes it deterministically in the sandbox, and returns the analysis summary plus a Chart.js spec. The script is persisted as a versioned, re-runnable analysis artifact. Reads go through authorize(): denied cells are excluded, never leaked.

name: rerun_analysis
description: Deterministically re-execute a stored analysis artifact: re-reads the same range, re-runs the exact persisted Python script in the sandbox, and reports whether the input data changed since the original run. The stored artifact is immutable (auditability); the fresh result is returned, not persisted over it.

name: list_analyses
description: List stored analysis artifacts (newest first): id, intent, intent kind, range, script version, creation time. The full Python source is NOT returned here; fetch it via rerun_analysis semantics or the artifact store.

name: execute_code
description: Run code in the Icecream Sheets sandbox. JavaScript: the script completion value is the result and `args` holds the inputs. Python: `args` is a dict and the program must assign `result`.

name: list_data_sources
description: List the registered connector kinds and the data sources currently bound to this workbook's sheets. Connected data lives in the engine, so read_cells sees it like any other sheet.

name: open_data_source
description: Fetch a data source through a connector and materialize it as a new sheet in the typed computational view. The connector spec is stored as a source binding for later refresh_data_source calls. Secrets are never accepted here: authenticate with a vault credentialRef, not a secret value.

name: refresh_data_source
description: Re-fetch the connector behind a bound sheet and atomically swap its data region (writes then stale-tail clears, in one pass). Cells outside the previously materialized region are never touched.

name: rtd_publish
description: Publish a real-time data value to an RTD topic. Cells using RTD(progId, server, topic, ...) update on the next recalculation, which this tool triggers automatically.
